subject: maths
question: The interest, compounded annually, on a sum of Rs. 3,240 after two years is Rs. 370. What is the rate of interest, correct up to two decimal places?
solution:
Given: 

The interest, compounded annually, on a sum of Rs. 3,240 after two years is Rs. 370.

Concept used:

Compound interest, CI = P(1 + R/100)n - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the rate of interest be R%.

According to the question,

3240 (1 + R/100)² = 3240 + 370

⇒ (1 + R/100)2 = 361/324

⇒ (1 + R/100) = 19/18

⇒ R ≈ 5.56 

∴ The rate of interest is 5.56%.
